annotations.title: Get a Church Slavonic inflection table

description:
Fetch the full declension (nominals) or conjugation (verbs) table for a
lemma identified by a search result's inflection handle (entry_id +
word_class). Use this only when a search ran without inline forms or left a
match un-expanded — a default search already returns each match's table
inline. Returns Markdown plus the table as structuredContent with the shape
{"result": <paradigm>} per the declared outputSchema — switch on
result.category ('nominal' | 'verbal' | 'not_found') before reading the body.
Content from en.wiktionary.org (CC BY-SA 4.0).

entry_id.description: The Wiktionary page title (the Cyrillic lemma) from a search result's inflection handle, e.g. 'богъ', 'глаголати'.
entry_id.title: Entry Id

word_class.description: The part-of-speech section from a search result's inflection handle, e.g. 'verb', 'noun', 'adjective'.
word_class.title: Word Class

name: slavonic_get_inflections

ParadigmNotFound.description:
No inflection table for this page/POS (no Old Church Slavonic section, no
table, or the page doesn't exist). ``found`` is False and there is no body.

SlavonicNominalParadigm.description:
Declension of a noun/adjective/pronoun/etc.: case → {singular, dual, plural}.

Gender-split tables (adjectives, pronouns, participles) carry the gender — and,
for adjectives, the short/long variant — in the key: 'nominative masculine',
'long nominative feminine'. ``category`` discriminates this from the verbal and
not-found shapes — switch on it before reading the body.

cases.description: Case key (lower-case: 'nominative', 'genitive', …; gender and short/long variant prefixed when the table splits by them) → its singular/dual/plural forms, in table order.

SlavonicNumberForms.description:
A declension cell: the THREE number forms of one case — Old Church Slavonic
keeps a full dual. Forms are verbatim normalized OCS Cyrillic; alternates stay
comma-separated as Wiktionary renders them. A number the table doesn't give
(defective paradigms) is an empty string.
SlavonicNumberForms.title: SlavonicNumberForms

SlavonicVerbalParadigm.description:
Conjugation of a verb, grouped the way Wiktionary's table is: finite cells
keyed by tense/mood → person-and-number → form, plus the non-finite sections
(infinitive, supine, l-participle and the other participles).

finite.description: Tense/mood (lower-case, e.g. 'present', 'imperfect', 'aorist', 'imperative') → person and number ('first singular' … 'third dual' … 'third plural') → the form. Periphrastic rows (perfect, pluperfect, future) appear under the single key 'all'. Alternates are comma-separated; an em-dash cell (no such form) is omitted.
finite.title: Finite

nonfinite.description: Non-finite section ('infinitive', 'supine', 'l-participle') → label ('form' for the single-form sections; 'singular masculine' etc. for the participle) → the form.
nonfinite.title: Nonfinite
